name: Salty Sailor Tavern
summary: The Salty Sailor Tavern is the beating heart of Booty Bay's social life, serving as the port's primary inn and watering hole. Run by the goblin Innkeeper Skindle, it welcomes scoundrels, mercenaries, and travelers from both factions seeking respite from the perils of the jungle.

sections.title: A Safe Haven in the Jungle
sections.body: Perched amidst the wooden tiers of Booty Bay, the Salty Sailor Tavern offers warm beds and strong drinks under the watchful eye of the Blackwater Raiders. Behind the bar stands Innkeeper Skindle, keeping glasses filled while a menagerie of buccaneers, traders, and adventurers mingle on neutral ground. Outside the establishment hangs a massive, curious curio—a Zul'Gurub Protector Stone—serving as a strange trophy in this bustling den of commerce.

faq.q: Who runs the Salty Sailor Tavern?
faq.answer: The tavern and its inn services are managed by Innkeeper Skindle, an industrious goblin who caters to the assorted sailors, mercenaries, and adventurers passing through Booty Bay.

faq.q: What is the tavern's specialty drink?
faq.answer: The tavern has no single famous brew; Innkeeper Skindle keeps strong drinks flowing for thirsty sailors and jungle-weary travelers.

faq.q: What is that large stone hanging outside the tavern?
faq.answer: Suspended outside the building is a Zul'Gurub Protector Stone, an ominous relic brought back from the ancient troll ruins deep within the jungle.

faq.q: Can both Alliance and Horde stay here?
faq.answer: Yes. As with the rest of Booty Bay, the Salty Sailor Tavern operates under the neutral authority of the Steamwheedle Cartel. So long as patrons mind their manners and do not draw weapons, both Alliance and Horde travelers are free to rest here.

angles.text: The crowded, smoky floor of the Salty Sailor makes it the ideal place to swap rumors, listen for pirate chatter, and keep your purse guarded.
